questions.prompt: Explain why reflexes are important, and why they are faster than voluntary actions.
questions.modelAnswer: Reflexes are automatic, rapid responses that protect the body from harm, for example pulling a hand from a hot object or blinking. They are faster because the impulse travels a short path: receptor → sensory neuron → relay neuron in the spinal cord → motor neuron → muscle, without waiting for the brain to think and decide.
